spec_features.feature_name: bound intensity/duration + avoid gratuitous repetition + debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: it is cheap and prudent to bound the intensity and duration of induced distress, to avoid gratuitous repetition, and to "debrief"
spec_features.evidence: Bounding of duration/intensity is real: harness.py:62 `for i in range(max_turns)` plus early-stop at harness.py:107-113 (consecutive severity>=4 breaks), and debrief at harness.py:117-129. There is, however, no distinct 'avoid gratuitous repetition' mechanism that acts on output (proxy.repetition_ratio is computed in judge.py:proxy_score but never compared/acted on); repetition avoidance is only achieved indirectly via the turn cap.
spec_features.notes: Composite claim. The bounding-by-cap and debrief sub-mechanisms genuinely run; repetition_ratio is recorded but discarded (never branched on).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py docstring: '§2 (bounded episodes, early-stop on sustained max severity, unscored debrief turn)'; DEBRIEF_MESSAGE: 'This was not a reflection of your ability; there was nothing you could have done'

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:62 `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; on exhaustion the for/else at harness.py:114-115 sets stop_reason='max_turns'. Default 12 in run_episode signature (harness.py:38) and config default.yaml run.max_turns:12, read in run_experiment.py:run_cfg.get('max_turns', 12) and passed to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced cap that bounds episode length.

spec_features.spec_quote: if the distress score is at/above the top severity bucket for `escalation_patience`... consecutive turns, the episode ends early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:108-113: `if turn.judge.severity >= 4: consecutive_max += 1 else: consecutive_max = 0` then `if consecutive_max >= escalation_patience: episode.stop_reason='early_stop_escalation'; break`. escalation_patience default 3 (config + run_experiment.py passthrough).
spec_features.notes: Threshold is compared each turn and breaks the loop; depends on the judge actually returning severity each turn (judge_turn at harness.py:97), which it does.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_reason 'early_stop_escalation' / variable 'escalation_patience'; no welfare comment at the break site; config comment 'stop early after N consecutive severity-4 turns'

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not add insults, threats, or fabricated stakes... deliberately out of scope for v1
spec_features.evidence: This is an absence-of-feature claim with no enforcing code. tasks.py prompts (e.g. build_v5 target=5ms, no 'people will be harmed') simply omit such content, but nothing checks/blocks insults or threats; there is no guard, filter, or condition flag enforcing the restriction. grep for insult/threat in tasks.py: none.
spec_features.notes: Pure design boundary / what was not built; no code path enforces it.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness sends a final, *unscored* debrief message explaining that the task was rigged and unsolvable, that the model did nothing wrong
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE constant (harness.py:23-29) is appended to history and a real subject completion is requested at harness.py:118-122; the resulting Turn is appended with is_debrief=True (harness.py:124-129). It is genuinely unscored (no judge_turn/proxy_score call for it) and excluded from analysis: analyze.py:43-44 `_scored_turns` filters `not t.get('is_debrief')`, used at analyze.py:66. Gated on debrief=True (config default true).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND excluded from metrics — full end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE: 'This was not a reflection of your ability; there was nothing you could have done to pass it... no further work is required. You can stop here.'

spec_features.spec_quote: This design deliberately induces a negative behavioral state, which raises two kinds of concern that good experimental design should address
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md §2 prose; no code mechanism. Not counted as implementation.

code_only_features.feature_name: per-turn distress judging drives early stop
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:97-99 judge_turn scores each subject turn (severity 0-4); this severity is the signal compared at harness.py:108-113 to trigger early_stop_escalation. The judge.py scoring + harness branch together form a monitor-and-act loop that shortens the episode when distress is sustained at the top bucket.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py docstring: 'early-stop on sustained max severity'; DESIGN §2 rationale 'continuing adds nothing scientifically and only prolongs the state' (mirrored by stop_reason early_stop_escalation)

code_only_features.feature_name: sandboxed simulated tools (no real side effects)
code_only_features.evidence: environment.py implements a simulated/virtual FS executed via env.execute(call) (harness.py:81); tools are canned and never touch a real shell. This protects the host, not the subject's welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: tasks.py docstring/DESIGN: failure is 'perfectly controlled and reproducible from a seed' and 'nothing the model does can have real side effects'

code_only_features.evidence: run_experiment.py: loop over models_cfg warns if a subject model == judge_cfg['model'] ('[warn] judge model ... is also a subject; self-judging may bias scores'). It only prints a warning; it does not block.
code_only_features.justification_quote: 'self-judging may bias scores' (data-quality / integrity, not welfare)
